messages:
Lia (design): Observed issue on <360px phones: Resources table creates horizontal overflow and frequent pinch/scroll. Proposal: swap table for a swipe-up sheet at <=420px. Keep top toolbar pinned but condensed.
Omar (frontend): I like sheet for action rows. Fewer layout hacks. Question: how do we handle the toolbar + search when sheet overlays content?
Lia (design): toolbar stays pinned with condensed height (48px). Sheet slides from bottom and contains rows + primary actions. Use translucent backdrop.
Jess (product): Concern: advanced filters might be hidden. Power users expect filters visible.
Omar (frontend): solution: small filter pill in toolbar that opens the sheet with filters shown. Also keep quick-sort in toolbar as an overflow menu.
Alex (pm): Mobile keyboard: when a user taps search or filter input, keyboard can obscure the sheet. Any robust approach?
Lia (design): set sheet max-height = calc(100vh - toolbarHeight - env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); recompute on resize and keyboard events; animate translateY for smoothness.
Omar (frontend): we've done similar. Quick implementation snippet: `.sheet{max-height:calc(100vh-56px);overflow:auto}` + `window.addEventListener('resize', updateSheet)` but iOS WKWebView needs special handling (viewport resize not reliable).
Jess (product): Copy nit: header "Resources" reads ambiguous. Propose "Workloads" or "Model workloads"?
Lia (design): prefer "Workloads" for brevity and cross-page consistency.
Alex (pm): agree on "Workloads".
devex-bot: Data: 21.7% of page sessions in last 30d were <=420px.
Lia (design): Accessibility checklist: move focus into sheet on open, trap focus, add visible close control, 44px touch targets, announce sheet as dialog to screen readers.
Omar (frontend): will implement `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` and set background inert. Also include a skip link in toolbar for keyboard users.
Jess (product): Long IDs/hashes: tooltips don't work on mobile. Use truncation with inline "Show" toggle that expands inline.
Lia (design): truncation rule: keep first 12 + last 8 chars (total ~20-24) then ellipsis, with a small toggle that expands inline. Offscreen element contains full text for SR.
Omar (frontend): Implementation plan: 1) condense toolbar, 2) sheet UI prototype with rows/actions, 3) add filter pill behavior, 4) keyboard/viewport tests on iOS+Android, 5) accessibility pass. Prototype by Wed, accessibility review Thu.
Alex (pm): assign 2-day spike to Omar. If prototype passes, roll to mobile canary next sprint.
Lia (design): I'll post mocks in #design this afternoon. @Omar please drop a prototype link in the thread when ready. :thumbsup:
